overview_candidate: Use small pulls, avoid knockbacks into nearby packs, and interrupt caster Fear. Watch your breath during underwater sections.

bosses.name: Zul'Alai
bosses.tip: Move away during Monstrous Slam. Prioritize removing Rotted Strike from the tank and prepare extra healing for the late enrage.

bosses.name: Var'Taka
bosses.tip: Control or kill the priestesses before their heals prolong the fight. Face the boss away from allies and clear nearby packs before pulling.

bosses.name: Captain Dreadrise
bosses.tip: Break Abyssal Bubbles to free trapped players, including the tank. Interrupt Waterbolt Volley and clear patrols before the pull.

bosses.name: Primeval Elemental
bosses.tip: Defeat the Undying Offerings to activate this optional boss. Watch your breath and surface when needed; prepare healing for Freeze Water.

bosses.name: Min'loth the Serpent
bosses.tip: Save resources for the serpent phase after the troll form falls. Cleanse poison promptly and prepare for Fear.
